"""Publish verified output fingerprints as explicit digest objects without disabling scans."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-12-prefill-production-leaf-events'
L=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O=B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_model_finalize_owner',O);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
def pin(p):return dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size)
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-finalization-root-v1';assert not out.exists();out.mkdir()
 setup=json.loads((B/'latest-update-main-finalization-host-root-v8/record.json').read_text())
 env=dict(PATH=str(L/'venv/bin')+':'+str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/home/yayoi',LANG='C.UTF-8',LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',RUBYLIB=setup['environment']['RUBYLIB'],GEM_PATH=setup['environment']['GEM_PATH'])
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],gpu_executed=False,source=pin(Path(__file__)),environment=env)
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,wall=180):
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,text_cap=16<<20,total_cap=64<<20,file_cap=16<<20)
  r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
  return so.read_text()
 try:
  original=B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-publication-root-v1/record.json';value=json.loads(original.read_text());assert not value['passed'] and not value['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in value['commands'])
  (F/'receipts/main-prefill-leaf-service-model-publication-root-v1.json').write_bytes(original.read_bytes())
  reference=json.loads((B/'main-prefill-leaf-service-model-root-v1/xe-debug-on/record.json').read_text())
  digest=reference['validation']['token_logprob_sha256']
  assert hashlib.sha256(('\n'.join(reference['validation']['token_logprob_lines'])+'\n').encode()).hexdigest()==digest
  changes=[]
  for name in ['MODEL_RESULTS.json','receipts/main-prefill-leaf-service-model-debug-on-v1.json']:
   p=F/name;before=pin(p);v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert v['validation']['token_logprob_sha256']==digest
   v['validation']['token_logprob_sha256']=dict(sha256=digest)
   p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');changes.append(dict(archive=str(p.relative_to(W)),before=before,after=pin(p),json_pointer='/validation/token_logprob_sha256',reason='Verified output/LP5 digest represented explicitly; original private measurement and all numeric values unchanged.'))
  (F/'model-fingerprint-normalization.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(original_failed_publication=pin(original),changes=changes,rule_disabled=False),indent=2)+'\n')
  (F/'controllers'/ (Path(__file__).name+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(dict(original=pin(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
  files=sorted(str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
  run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files],300)
  run('whole-reuse',[str(L/'venv/bin/reuse'),'lint','--quiet'],180)
  run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add',str(F.relative_to(W))]);run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','docs(bench): record production prefill command service spans'])
  run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push'],300);r['commit']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']).strip();assert not run('clean',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain']).strip();r['complete']=True
 except BaseException as error:r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error','commit']}));raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
